description: This file is a code-behind for the MCQExam ASP.NET page, managing the retrieval and display of multiple-choice questions from a SQL database, handling user responses, timing, and navigation within an online examination system.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Partial class for managing the MCQ exam page logic, including loading questions from the database, handling submission, timing, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes questions from the database based on session info; sets timer for the exam.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the score based on user-selected answers, stores results in database, and navigates to the exam result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and navigation to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display, triggers timeout handling when time expires.
